verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way for authorized third parties such as law firms, HRIS vendors or wealth managers to get scoped, delegated access to equity data. The admin-controlled visibility (cake-equity-docs-14, cake-equity-docs-46) applies to stakeholders viewing their own holdings in the My Cake portal, not to third-party delegation. The read-only MCP connection (cake-equity-docs-27) and the registered-agent notifications (cake-equity-docs-21) are adjacent features that earn no credit here.
